First of all, this is the best surgery in London, and I don't say this lightly. The quality of care I've received at this practice (sometimes on a daily basis) has been the difference between life and death.

Everyone at this practice is fantastic, from the receptionists (shout-out to the receptionists and please show them kindness because they are amazing. Massive big-up to Samantha, Inez, Margaret and everyone at the front desk. You are phenomenal. Thank you) to the nurses (the legendary Jean and fabulous Flora—thank you sincerely.
